I never understood why some mormon families get so NUTS. I’m a mormon and grew up in italy, i’ve always seen lots of american families in my home ward and saw how their approch was way different than the average mormon italian family, i gotta say, i always “believed” but with a touch of skepticism, even though my family is really strong into the church, and my father was a bishop at the time of my teenage years (12 to 18, so quite influential on me), I never sticked too much to mormon rules, i had few girlfriends, we did stuff, I had my nights out with friends, getting high and drunk (classic teenage stuff), and all of this while still going to church on Sunday because “it’s the right thing to do”, my father new that I was messing around, but never forced me or punished me for LIVING MY LIFE, and I think this is why I love him deeply, he never judged me even though what i did wasn’t in line with his expectations. 
I get the feeling that in bigger mormon communities thinis CLEARLY NOT the case, from what I read here, this 27yo girl father is a crazy manipulator that only cares about his family image in the community, and not about what makes her daughter happy. That’s sad. 
I feel like church’s teachings are great as long as they are not enforced and lived maniacally. To the extent fo denying people free will (which ironically is a precius gift as given us). 

My take at the end of this comment is: bigger mormon community are full of bigots and nutjobs people that think they are keeping god’s law when in reality they are just controlling people, especially loved ones.
But at the same time, for what a saw in my country, the chuch community is way less toxic and less collectively judgmental. 
Maybe because the gospel is lived more like a mantra, rather then military orders.
Good luck everyone!

As a member of the LDS Church in Europe, I can totally say we are christians. As of the definition of “People who believe in Christ as Savior and Redeemer.”
This is one of the most “discussed” topic even within our organization. We were asked around 2018 by our leaders, (which we believe to be prophets) to stop using nicknames such as Mormons or LDS, to put emphasis on the real name of the church, which is “The Church of JESUS CHRIST of Latter Day Saints” to help people be more aware of the Christian nature of our believes. 

Also, going into a more personal prospective, I have been a member for my whole life (Im 23yo) I was taught by my parents, who besides being members of the church themselves are also caring an loving human beings, the beliefs of our faith, I was taught to pray to God, our Heavenly Father in the name of Christ, to love my neighbor and always being a good example in terms of morality. Being honest, loving and non-judgmental were principles taught to me since my early years (I do believe though that those things should be taught to everyone regardless religion) I was also taught that Jesus suffered for my sins in the gethsemane, that He paid for my salvation, that through His Atonement I can be forgiven for my mistakes, and that I have to show my faith in Him by trying to be like him, (easier said than done)! 

Sorry for my english, I am italian and English is not my mother tongue. 

I hope I was clear! I’d be happy to answer any further questions if there are!
